name: dateutils
author: Sebastian Freundt
description: dateutils: date arithmetic in the Terminal. dateadd, datediff, dateseq, dateconv, dateround, datetest, dategrep and strptime count days, weeks, months and business days. Type datediff 2026-10-02 2026-12-25.
usage:
dateadd: dateadd DATE +45d|+3w|+2mo|+10b (b = business days) [-f FMT]
datediff: datediff D1 D2 [-f '%d days' | '%w weeks %d days' | '%m months %d days']
dateseq: dateseq FROM [+STEP] TO
dateconv: dateconv DATE -f '%A %d %B %Y' [-i INFMT]
dateround: dateround DATE Mon|month|...
datetest: datetest D1 --lt|--le|--eq|--ge|--gt D2 (exit status)
dategrep: dategrep '>=2026-10-01' < FILE
strptime: strptime -i '%d/%m/%Y' 02/10/2026
Dates are ISO (2026-10-02); now and today work; times are UTC.

descriptions.en: dateutils: date arithmetic in the Terminal. dateadd, datediff, dateseq, dateconv, dateround, datetest, dategrep and strptime count days, weeks, months and business days. Type datediff 2026-10-02 2026-12-25.
descriptions.it: dateutils: calcoli con le date nel Terminale. dateadd, datediff, dateseq, dateconv, dateround, datetest, dategrep e strptime contano giorni, settimane, mesi e giorni lavorativi. Scrivi datediff 2026-10-02 2026-12-25.

does.en: Date arithmetic: days between dates, date + N days/weeks/months/business days, date series, formats. Run: datediff 2026-10-02 2026-12-25 | dateadd 2026-10-02 +10b
does.it: Calcoli con le date: giorni tra due date, data + N giorni/settimane/mesi/giorni lavorativi, serie, formati. Uso: datediff 2026-10-02 2026-12-25 | dateadd 2026-10-02 +10b
